ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\square ABCD$, $AC$ is the diagonal, $\angle ACD=90^\circ$, point $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $AF$ bisects $\angle BAC$, $CF\perp AF$ at point $F$, and $EF$ is connected. Given $AB=5$ and $BC=13$, what is the length of $EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Extend $AB$ and $CF$ to meet at point $H$, \\
$\because$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram, \\
$\therefore AB\parallel CD$, \\
$\therefore \angle ACD=\angle BAC=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore AC=\sqrt{BC^{2}-AB^{2}}=\sqrt{169-25}=12$, \\
$\because AF$ bisects $\angle BAC$, \\
$\therefore \angle BAF=\angle CAF=45^\circ$, \\
In $\triangle AFH$ and $\triangle AFC$, \\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle HAF=\angle CAF \\
AF=AF \\
\angle AFH=\angle AFC=90^\circ
\end{array}\right.$, \\
$\therefore \triangle AFH \cong \triangle AFC\left(ASA\right)$, \\
$\therefore AC=AH=12$, $HF=CF$, \\
$\therefore BH=AH-AB=7$, \\
$\because$ Point $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $HF=CF$, \\
$\therefore EF=\frac{1}{2}BH=\boxed{\frac{7}{2}}$,

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a parallelogram ABCD, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, and D is at the upper right; AC is the diagonal from A to C. Point E is located on BC, and the angle bisector AF starting from A is also drawn in the figure; point F is below, CF and AF intersect at F, and EF is also connected. Reasoning: Because ABCD is a parallelogram, AB ∥ CD. It is known that ∠ACD=90°, therefore from the parallel-line relationship it can be obtained that ∠BAC=90°. In right triangle ABC, BC=13, AB=5, so AC=sqrt(BC^2-AB^2)=sqrt(13^2-5^2)=sqrt(169-25)=12. According to the method, extend AB and CF to intersect at H. Because AF bisects ∠BAC, ∠BAF=∠CAF=45°; also H is on the extension of AB, so ∠HAF=∠CAF. Since CF ⟂ AF, and H, F, C are collinear, ∠AFH=∠AFC=90°. In triangles AFH and AFC, ∠HAF=∠CAF, AF is a common side, and ∠AFH=∠AFC=90°, therefore the two triangles are congruent. Thus AH=AC=12, HF=CF, that is, F is the midpoint of CH. Also AB=5, so BH=AH-AB=12-5=7. E is the midpoint of BC, and F is the midpoint of CH, therefore EF is the midline of triangle BCH, EF=BH/2=7/2.
